channel.title: SecondBrain Blog
channel.description: Second brains, AI memory and voice notes, from the maker of SecondBrain.

item.title: What is a second brain? The definition, the methods, and what AI changes
item.dc:creator: Federico Cesarini
item.description: A second brain is a trusted system outside your head for what you want to remember. Where the idea comes from, CODE and PARA, and what AI changes.

item.title: The best second brain apps in 2026, by how you actually capture
item.dc:creator: Federico Cesarini
item.description: Fifteen second brain apps compared on capture, free plans, prices, AI, ChatGPT and Claude access, and export. Checked against each vendor in October 2026.

item.title: How to use ChatGPT as a second brain, and what it still forgets
item.dc:creator: Federico Cesarini
item.description: What ChatGPT's memory, chat history and Projects can hold in 2026, where they stop, and how to give ChatGPT a second brain it can read and share with Claude.

item.title: How to turn voice memos into organized notes on iPhone and Android
item.dc:creator: Federico Cesarini
item.description: Transcribing a voice memo is the easy part. How to get from a rambling recording to a titled, filed note with real reminders, on iPhone and Android.

item.title: Secondo cervello digitale: cos'è, da dove nasce e come costruirlo parlando
item.dc:creator: Federico Cesarini
item.description: Un secondo cervello è un sistema esterno di cui ti fidi per ricordare. Da dove nasce l'idea, i metodi CODE e PARA e cosa cambia con l'AI e la voce.
